label: Manifest validator (onboarding)
description: Validate the onboarding control-center manifest and emit MCP-friendly JSON

label: Workshop · start all jobs
description: Use the noun-first Workshop command surface to trigger every queued job (wraps Start-AllLabJobs).

label: Workshop · stop all jobs
description: Gracefully stop every running Workshop job via the new Workshop-Job-StopAll alias (force flag removed for catalog safety).

label: Workshop · job dashboard
description: List all Workshop jobs with their state and timestamps (alias for Show-LabJobs).

label: Workshop · job snapshot
description: Capture the Workshop job manifest snapshot for tail-log troubleshooting (wraps Get-LabJobSnapshot).

label: Rebrand · dry run
description: Preview the config-driven rename/reset workflow without modifying files (mirrors control_center.py rebrand --dry-run).

label: Rebrand · apply plan
description: Execute the current rebrand plan (edit configs/rebrand_plan.example.json or pass a custom path before running).

label: Ops workflow harness
command: python scripts/workflow_harness.py --notes "Ops Deck request" --goal-milestone "Ops workflow harness" --goal-summary "Scripted release + docs harness run from Ops Deck" --goal-artifacts "`scripts/workflow_harness.py`, `docs/AGENT_OPERATIONS.md`" --timeline-json data/logs/workflow_harness/latest.json --timeline-jsonl data/logs/workflow_harness/history.jsonl
description: Run the composite release → docs → change record → rebrand workflow without shell access (dry-run release, doc updates, change record scaffolding). Emits machine-readable timeline logs under data/logs/workflow_harness/, logs to data/logs/release.log, and appends a tail-log entry for Ops Deck telemetry.

label: Release log · inspect
description: Headless reader for data/logs/release.log with filters and timeline output. Use --json for MCP-friendly automation or add --status failed to focus on bad runs.
